messages:
kevin: Starting a targeted sleuth for osmium14b int4 quality+OOM anomalies. Repro: heavy longform QA workload, many requests >700 tokens, intermittent OOMs and a subtle repeat-loop in outputs for some prompts.
anya: Can you share the exact runtime args and a short stdout/stderr snippet?
kevin: runtime: microbatch=1 batch=6 prefetch_window=192 prefetch_padding=0 max_new_tokens=1024. stderr: ```RuntimeError: CUDA OOM while allocating 1.25 GiB
slab: longest_free_chunk=672MB total_free=2.1GB
alloc timeline: prefetch->kv_map->attn_alloc->decode```
leah: That longest_free_chunk vs total_free is fragmentation. The repetition in outputs could be a quant-decoding artifact when attention KV is partially evicted/reshuffled. Two hypothesis: (A) prefetch is creating many small slabs that prevent contiguous big allocs, (B) lowering max_new_tokens avoids the large contiguous allocation and masks both OOM and repeat artifact.
kevin: Quick experiments: (1) prefetch_window=48 + max_new_tokens=512 -> 0 OOMs in 2k requests, repeats gone; (2) prefetch_window=48 + max_new_tokens=1024 -> rare OOMs; (3) add prefetch_padding=64 with window=192 -> fewer OOMs but still occasional failure.
anya: Root cause seems to be contiguous allocation pressure. Proposal: add a new model-config knob `max_prefetch_bytes` and a runtime compact-on-failure that tries to coalesce free slabs for up to 150ms before soft-evicting 10-25% of KV. Also for onboarding, set conservative model default: max_new_tokens=512 for int4 variants.
leah: I ran a microbench enabling compact-on-failure (ff on): p95 up ~2% but OOMs -> 0 for 5k requests. Need full eval on ROUGE/BERTScore to ensure no quality drop from conservative max_new_tokens.
mira: Filed ML-1707: "osmium14b int4 onboarding: max_prefetch_bytes + compact-on-failure + conservative max_new_tokens". Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/osmium14b/int4/sleuth-6278904321.
kevin: Plan: 1) land compact-on-failure behind ff with telemetry (compact_attempts, reclaimed_bytes, soft_evicts), 2) add `max_prefetch_bytes` and per-model override for prefetch_window/padding, 3) set canary defaults for int4: max_new_tokens=512, max_prefetch_bytes=1GB, prefetch_padding=64, 4) run full summarization+longform sweep and post results.
anya: SGTM. If compact frequency is high we pivot to stronger prefetch heuristics (adaptive window capped by bytes).
kevin: Ok will open PR for compact and model-config change. Will post sweep links when done. Thanks.
